findings.message: R11 accepts the most lenient statistic (the highest-contrast pixel) and relies on a reviewer reading the table to catch a pass carried by a thin edge.
findings.suggestion: Consider also recording, per row, the share of band pixels at or above the threshold, so the table shows such cases.

findings.message: The per-test timeout rationale says 120 s stays under NFR-102 5 minutes for the whole set; a per-test limit does not bound the set, which several such tests could exceed. The timed runs of section 10 step 5 are what prove NFR-102 AC-2, so behaviour is unaffected.
findings.suggestion: Say that 120 s bounds a single test and that the set time is checked by the section 10 timed runs.
